                (column_reference
                  (identifier)))))))
      (function_call
        (identifier)
        (arguments
          (column_reference
            (identifier)))

          (window_specification

                (column_reference
                  (identifier))))
            (frame_clause
              (frame_bound)
              (frame_bound)))))

        (arguments
          (column_reference
            (identifier)))

          (window_specification
